fxUsdJpy.calculation: Board H.10 daily Japanese yen per US dollar. Weekly published business-date observations, distinct from a live tradable quote.
fxUsdJpy.attribution: Source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Foreign Exchange Rates - H.10.
fxUsdJpy.coverageNote: H.10 daily yen per US dollar from 2020. Weekly releases describe the preceding week, not current market quotes. ND source dates remain null. No interpolation or release timestamp is invented.
